column_maps.format: compressed NumPy NPZ; 2D maps only; no interpolation

coverage_limits: unadjusted residual precedes cutoff and ice/snow transition corrections; adjusted residual subtracts only those two recorded terms
both residuals omit stored-rounding and other numerical terms
same-call host hybrid dry-mass and boundary reconciliation are not captured
not a closed whole-model water or thermodynamic budget

rain_ground_comparison.comparison: helper ground-approved rain Q versus captured public fall phase 1 mapped through rainncv
rain_ground_comparison.interpretation: The helper ledger and public output accumulator disagree; ground-approved process Q is not substituted for emitted precipitation.
rain_ground_comparison.unit_basis: ground_approved_q is kg m-2 per call times actual map area; public fall phase 1 uses source fall*DELZ/DENR*DTCLD*1000 mm times water density/1000 and map area

recorded_numerical_terms.cutoff_sweep_assignment: first full ordered j sweep; every row rhoDry matches first-call PRE capture and second sweep has changed rhoDry rows

residual_after_recorded_numerical_terms.interpretation: water-state change + bottom outflow - recorded cutoff water delta - recorded ice/snow storage delta

unadjusted_water_residual.interpretation: water-state change + bottom outflow before recorded cleanup/phase-storage corrections

geometry_availability.DELZ: captured in first-call KDM6 PRE/POST files only; not alongside per-step PRE_RK/POST_KDM6 stage states
geometry_availability.area: static map area derivable from initial MAPFAC_MX/MAPFAC_MY and DX*DY
geometry_availability.reason: endpoint DELZ is absent from the full stage trace, so rhoDry*DELZ*area cannot be applied to both state endpoints without assuming fixed layer thickness
geometry_availability.rhoDry: captured at every PRE_RK/POST_KDM6 state as DEN
geometry_availability.units_of_reported_changes: native Q/B mixing or moment state units; not kg, particles, or column inventory
